items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: One happy hour they had the Jimmy Lunceford Orchestra.

ctx.x: Yeah. With the baton kind of?
Yeah. And so they would have happy hours. And when they would have happy hours you would have the entertainment that would come in. One happy hour they had the Jimmy Lunceford Orchestra.
